# Bouldeer

> Bouldeer (www.bouldeer.com) is a free map of indoor climbing gyms for climbers who travel: more than 3,600 bouldering, top rope and lead climbing gyms in over 80 countries, with addresses, climbing types, directions and, where confirmed, day-pass prices and opening hours. It is available in English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.

Bouldeer is useful when someone asks where to go bouldering or climbing in a city they are visiting. Each gym is researched from its own website, social accounts and public map listings and checked before it is listed; unconfirmed details are marked as not confirmed rather than guessed. Bouldeer is not connected to the gyms, takes no bookings and sells no passes: visitors buy passes and book with the gym. Many gyms in China, Japan and South Korea carry their name and address in the local script, and Chinese addresses link to Amap. Use is free, without ads and without an account; an account adds saved gyms, check-ins (passport stamps per city) and a session logbook. Formerly called Climb Atlas.

## Find gyms

- [Map and search](https://www.bouldeer.com/): search a city, country or gym in English or the local script (成都, 東京, 서울), filter by bouldering, top rope or lead. `https://www.bouldeer.com/?q=<city or gym>` opens a search.
- [All countries and regions](https://www.bouldeer.com/in): every country with gyms, grouped by continent.
- Country pages: `https://www.bouldeer.com/in/<country code>`, for example [Japan](https://www.bouldeer.com/in/jp) or [China](https://www.bouldeer.com/in/cn).
- City pages: `https://www.bouldeer.com/in/<country>/<region>/<city>`, for example [Sydney](https://www.bouldeer.com/in/au/nsw/sydney).
- Gym pages: `https://www.bouldeer.com/gym/<slug>`, with address, climbing types, directions, and day pass, hours and facilities where confirmed.
- [Sitemap](https://www.bouldeer.com/sitemap.xml): every country, region, city and gym page.
